name: What's the difference between a general home inspection and a dedicated siding inspection?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a general home inspection and a dedicated siding inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: A general home inspection provides a broad overview of a home's major systems, including a visual check of the siding as one component. A dedicated siding inspection, however, focuses solely and deeply on the exterior cladding. It involves a more detailed examination of material integrity, flashing, caulking, and potential moisture issues, offering a specialized assessment that goes beyond a standard home inspection.
acceptedAnswer.description: A general home inspection offers a broad overview, while a dedicated siding inspection provides a deeper, specialized assessment focusing exclusively on the exterior cladding's condition and integrity.
